newsitem.title: USA: BOC Ohmeda unit files NDA for inhale therapy.
newsitem.headline: BOC Ohmeda unit files NDA for inhale therapy.

text.p: Ohmeda, the healthcare business of BOC Group Plc, said Tuesday that it has submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the use of nitric oxide inhalation therapy in conjunction with mechanical ventilation for the treatment of respiratory failure in newborns.

When nitric oxide is inhaled, it dilates pulmonary blood vessels in ventilated parts of the lung. Nitric oxide in the lung produces greater blood flow to the ventilated regions and results in improved oxygen delivery in the patient.
